title: LTCF | Point of Care | NHSN | CDC
content: Point of Care Print Minus Related Pages The Point of Care (POC) Test Reporting Tool is a separate reporting option for LTCFs to report SARS-CoV-2 test results provided by a POC device. NHSN routes reported POC laboratory test result data to the public health agency at the local or state level with jurisdictional authority and responsibility for receiving those data.
